title: Localization of a morphism of ringed sites
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be small sites and let $u:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ be a continuous functor defining a morphism of sites $f:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$, so that $f_*G(T)=G(u(T))$ and its left adjoint $f^{-1}$ preserves finite limits [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let $R$ on $\mathcal D$ and $S$ on $\mathcal C$ be sheaves of commutative rings, with a ring map $c:f^{-1}R\to S$. For $V\in\mathcal D$ put $U=u(V)$ and give $\mathcal D/V$ and $\mathcal C/U$ the localized topology and restricted coefficient sheaves [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. The functor $u_V:(T\to V)\mapsto(u(T)\to u(V))$ defines a morphism of sites $f_V:\mathcal C/U\to\mathcal D/V$. There is a canonical natural isomorphism $(f_V)^{-1}j_V^{-1}\cong j_U^{-1}f^{-1}$, making the localization square commute as morphisms of topoi. The ring map for $f_V$ is $(f_V)^{-1}(R|_V)\cong(f^{-1}R)|_U\xrightarrow{c|_U}S|_U$. Use sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and the sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. For the module pullbacks $f^*M=S\otimes_{f^{-1}R}f^{-1}M$ and $(f_V)^*H=(S|_U)\otimes_{(f_V)^{-1}(R|_V)}(f_V)^{-1}H$, and module direct images with ring action through the adjuncts of these ring maps [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-module-adjunction], the square commutes as morphisms of ringed topoi, and there are canonical natural isomorphisms
$$ (f_V)^*j_V^*\cong j_U^*f^*,\qquad j_V^*f_*\cong(f_V)_*j_U^*. $$
The direct-image comparison on an object $T\to V$ is the identity $G(u(T))=G|_U(u(T)\to U)$ with its restricted $R(T)$-action.
